CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is elite enemy scale (30-50 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a OBJECTIVE unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Gate Anchor, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Elite.
Creature Category: Gateborn Hollow.
Combat Role: OBJECTIVE.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW GATE ANCHOR — An obsidian gate-stone torso rooted into the battlefield.

BODY: NOT a humanoid — the Gate Anchor is a massive BROKEN GATE-PIECE given partial life. The body is a large fragment of a Mythos Gate — dark obsidian stone, cracked and broken, shaped vaguely like a torso or a keystone. The stone is covered in white fracture cracks and embedded with broken arch-fragments. The Gate Anchor is rooted into the ground — it does not walk, it does not move from its position. It IS the ground, or rather, it IS the wound in the ground.

ARMS: Incomplete arms — only partial. One arm is a broken stone limb reaching upward, ending in a shattered hand of obsidian fragments. The other arm is just a stump — broken off, showing void-stuff at the core. The arms are made of the same Gate-stone as the torso, as if the Gate itself is reaching out.

CORE: The center of the Gate Anchor is a massive negative-space wound — a void-crater where the Gate's keystone should be. Inside the wound: ACTIVE NOTHING — the void that consumes, pulsing with cold white anti-light. This is the ANCHOR POINT — the place where the Hollow enters reality. The wound is the breach. Looking into it should feel like looking into the space between Realms.

CROWN: A broken arch-crown sits atop the torso — the top of a Gate-arch, cracked and leaning, made of dark obsidian stone. The arch frames the void above the Anchor, creating a mini-Gate that leads to nothing. Anti-light bleeds from the arch-crown.

GATE STONE: The entire creature IS Gate stone — but the central keystone fragment is the core. It is darker than the rest, more cracked, and pulses with the most intense anti-light. This is the heart of the breach.

POSE: Rooted into the ground, one arm reaching upward, arch-crown leaning. The Gate Anchor does not move — it is a STATIC objective on the battlefield. It looks like a broken piece of reality that has been driven into the earth like a stake. The arm reaching upward should look like the Gate is trying to rebuild itself but failing.

SCALE: 30-40 feet tall, rooted into a 50-foot radius of cracked ground. Camera at ground level, looking up at the massive broken Gate-fragment. The Gate Anchor should look like a WOUND IN THE EARTH — not a creature, but a place where reality has been torn open.

GROUND: The ground around the Gate Anchor is MASSIVELY DAMAGED — a 50-foot radius of total terrain corruption. Cracks radiating outward in white anti-light. The earth is being erased in patches — void-holes opening in the ground. Gate-fragments scattered in a ring around the Anchor. Ash falling upward in a wide column. This is a BREACH ZONE — the ground is actively being consumed.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that is BLEEDING through the Anchor — the void between Realms is visible through the core-wound. Distant broken Gate-arches are MORE visible near an Anchor — they are connected, part of the same broken network. The sky above the arch-crown shows the void, not the Realm's normal sky. Palette: obsidian-black, dark stone-grey, cold white, void-dark, anti-light blue-white.

VFX: Massive anti-light pulse from the core-wound. Arch-crown leaking void. Arm reaching and grasping at nothing. Terrain being erased in a spreading radius. The Gate Anchor should feel like a BEACON of absence — the loudest point of Hollow corruption on the battlefield.

SILHOUETTE: Tall, stone, rooted, arm reaching. Reads as an objective/structure unit — the gate-fragment shape and rooted position are the primary identifiers. Should look like a broken piece of a Mythos Gate driven into the earth, not a creature that walked there.
